value.rationale: Two separated equal observation windows yield almost degenerate bandlimited concentration modes, and their coupling determines spectral stability and near-optimal localized modes. The exact \(R^{-1}\) oscillatory splitting and positive commutator-defined Q_a identify a natural \(m^{-1}\) detuning where the leading \(m^{-2}\) gap vanishes. This is a structural boundary/crossover fact rather than routine reparametrization or an arbitrary numeric slice. The theorem does not determine the full spectrum or exact crossings.
